background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\"\u003EIncreased vascular permeability in acute pancreatitis causes the loss of intravenous fluid and reduces plasma volume. In severe cases, in patients with massive ascites, pleural effusion, and retroperitoneal and mesenteric edema, circulating plasma volume decreases markedly. Hypovolemia may lead to shock and acute renal failure, and, because hypovolemic shock may impair the pancreatic microcirculation and promote pancreatic ischemia and necrosis, restoration and maintenance of plasma volume is crucial in severe acute pancreatitis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC3205153\/\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\"\u003EThe pathophysiology of renal failure in multiple myeloma is often multifactorial but is mostly due to the high excretion of immunoglobulin free light chains. When the light chains combine with Tamm-Horsfall proteins, they form obstructing casts (\u003Ca class=\" bibr popnode tag_hotlink tag_tooltip\" co-class=\"co-refbox\" co-rid=\"B5\" href=\"https:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC3205153\/#B5\" id=\"__tag_328219526\" rid=\"B5\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003E5\u003C\/a\u003E). Chemotherapy should therefore be initiated rapidly to decrease light chain production. Intravenous fluids can be given to treat volume depletion, hypercalcemia, or hyperuricemia.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\"\u003E3)lungs(infection-incrsead susceptibility)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/www.cancer.org\/cancer\/multiple-myeloma\/causes-risks-prevention\/what-causes.html\" style=\"background: transparent; text-decoration-line: none; color: rgb(33, 150, 243);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.cancer.org\/cancer\/multiple-myeloma\/causes-risks-prevention\/what-causes.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"\u0026quot;Source Sans Pro\u0026quot;, sans-serif\"\u003EResearchers have found that patients with plasma cell tumors have important abnormalities in other bone marrow cells and that these abnormalities may also cause excess plasma cell growth. Certain cells in the bone marrow called\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cstrong\u003Edendritic cells\u003C\/strong\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"\u0026quot;Source Sans Pro\u0026quot;, sans-serif\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;release a hormone called interleukin-6 (IL-6), which stimulates normal plasma cells to grow. font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EWet beriberi is one of the clinical syndromes associated with thiamine deficiency. Thiamine, in its phosphorylated form thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP), is the precursor for the cofactor of both pyruvate dehydrogenase and alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, which are both key enzymes of the Krebs cycle. The Krebs cycle is an essential part of aerobic glucose metabolism. A decrease in the activity of these 2 enzymes due to thiamine deficiency may lead to the tissue accumulation of pyruvate and lactate.[1] Moreover, the accumulation of pyruvate and lactate decreases peripheral resistance and increases venous blood flow, increasing the cardiac preload. Increased preload and myocardial dysfunction ultimately leads to congestive heart failure.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.medindia.net\/patients\/patientinfo\/beriberi-disease.htm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EOther conditions cause beriberi include:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EExcessive alcohol usage, which results in inadequate intake in the diet as well as prevents the body from absorbing and storing vitamin B1.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EGenetic beriberi, which is an inherited condition where people lose the ability to absorb thiamine from foods. Symptoms usually present during adulthood.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EPregnancy; pregnant women often present with vitamin B1 deficiency. Breastfeeding infants can suffer from vitamin B1 deficiency if the mother is deficient.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EPeople with endocrine disorders like hyperthyroidism who require extra vitamin B1.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EChronic liver disease, which prevents the body from absorbing sufficient vitamin B1.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EKidney dialysis, which leads to a loss of vitamin B1.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003EA prolonged bout of diarrhea, which also leads to a loss of vitamin B1.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117); font-family: \u0026quot;Allerta Stencil\u0026quot;; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 248, 246);\"\u003E1) pharmacological interventions\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"color: rgb(117, 117, 117);
